title: Closing experiment: width sweep under the final tokenizer (V = 4k natural, L = 8)
purpose: The action-space analysis located the width knee at d ~ 224-256 (K_eff = 240) with the 24k production tokenizer, but the final model was chosen at d = 384 with the 4k natural tokenizer. This series tests whether the K_eff-informed knee survives the change of input representation: if d = 256 / V4k matches d = 384 / V4k, the final model can be the predicted-knee model (~7.3M); if not, the knee depends on input representation (a stated condition).

preregistered_predictions.P-X1: X256 is within 3 pp exact of V2 V4k (d=384) with the all-seeds sign rule not rejecting either direction; X224 is below X256 by an adopted margin (the knee is between 224 and 256 as with the 24k tokenizer).
preregistered_predictions.P-X2: Seed SD at X256 is not larger than 2x the SD at d=384 (knee-edge instability is the risk).
preregistered_predictions.decision_rule: Row-level McNemar per seed, Stouffer, Holm over adjacent steps and X256-vs-384; sign rule; plus seed-level t CI and hierarchical bootstrap as in seed_level_stats.py.
